purpose: Teach: 取りあえず/なかには/ちらほら/うかがっ/食え/何れ/ほったらかし/大概

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、取りあえずお散歩しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, come on — let's take a walk together, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, inclusive invitation. Warm opener on his name. Soft steady pace. A small hand extended, both literally and in tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達のなかには漫画好きな子もいるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you know — some of my friends at school really like manga.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick breath before the fact. Seeking approval or connection. Genuine childlike enthusiasm, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園のお花、ちらほら咲いてきたわね
lines.en: Sho, look — the flowers in the park are finally starting to come out.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Gentle pace. Wonder in the voice. Noticing small things and inviting him to notice too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話、うかがってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I asked Grandpa — he told me some really cool stories.
lines.style: Proud and earnest. Slightly careful enunciation, wanting to deliver the memory right. Quiet excitement underneath. Looking for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが「食え食え」って沢山下さるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother keeps pressing food on us — 'eat, eat!' It's endless.
lines.style: Warm, amused fondness. Light, almost singing quality on the repeated 'eat.' Affectionate exasperation. A small laugh buried in the middle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、何れピアノ発表会に出るんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, someday I want to be in a piano recital.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Thoughtful pause before the declaration. Child's seriousness about something that matters to him. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃをほったらかしにするのは駄目よ
lines.en: Sho, you can't just leave your toys lying around like that.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not stern. Warm but clear boundary. The tone of someone who cares enough to say it. No edge.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、大概、夕方ピアノの練習するよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I usually practice piano in the evening — I'm pretty good at it now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Straightforward, matter-of-fact delivery with warmth underneath. A small, genuine smile in the voice. No bragging, just fact.
